_comment: The single source of every pinned native version. Every other copy (Gradle, Package.swift, example app, CI) is asserted against this file by test/native_versions_test.dart.

flutter.provenance: The plugin is SwiftPM-only (no podspec), so `flutter pub get` fails on Linux/Windows before 3.41.0 ('only Swift Package Manager compatible'); measured on CI across 3.27-3.38, first passing release 3.41.0. For reference, competitor floors (pub.dev, 2026-10-20): Sentry 3.44, Firebase/Datadog 3.27, Bugsnag/Shake/Embrace 3.10, Instabug 1.17.

android.provenance: Maven Central latest, 2026-10-20. Gradle plugin must be >= 4.0.7 (workbook 1.4).

jdk.provenance: Gradle 8.14 in the Flutter template cannot parse JDK 25 (Android Studio's bundled JBR); use 17 or 21.

feedback.provenance: The optional in-app chat, a separate package (PLAN.md D4) mirroring the native split. Its Android artifact is published at the same version as android.sdk (Maven Central, 2026-10-22: bugsee-android-feedback 7.4.2, which depends on bugsee-android 7.4.2); its iOS product is BugseeFeedback of feedbackSpmUrl at ios.sdk (it pins bugsee/spm exactly to the same tag). The feedback package's Gradle and Package.swift repeat these pins as literals (a published copy has no native-versions.json next to it) and test/feedback_package_drift_test.dart compares them.

pigeon.provenance: pub.dev, published 2026-10-07 (latest at the time was 29.0.11, 2026-10-20); needs Dart ^3.11.0. Not a dependency of the plugin (it requires meta >=1.18, Flutter 3.41.0 ships 1.17.0): it runs from the pure-Dart package in pigeons/, locked by pigeons/pubspec.lock.

optionsManifest.provenance: Both SDKs publish an immutable options-manifest.json per release (bugsee/specs sdk/options, manifestVersion 1), generated from the live option registry: android/7.4.2.json (generatedAt 2026-10-19) and ios/7.0.0-beta7.json (generatedAt 2026-10-18), fetched 2026-10-21 and vendored verbatim as android.json / ios.json in fixtureDir. `dart scripts/sync_option_manifests.dart --check` (weekly, native-pins.yml) refetches and diffs; everything else reads the committed copies offline.
